script.source: if (ctx.event != null && ctx.event.ingested != null && ctx['@timestamp'] != null) { try { def ingested = java.time.Instant.parse(ctx.event.ingested.toString()).toEpochMilli(); def eventTime = java.time.Instant.parse(ctx['@timestamp'].toString()).toEpochMilli(); ctx.event.ingest_lag_ms = ingested - eventTime; } catch (Exception e) { } }

def status = ctx.agent.status.toString(); if (status == 'Idle') { ctx.agent.state = 'idle'; } else if (status == 'Closed') { ctx.agent.state = 'closed'; } else { ctx.agent.state = 'busy'; int open = status.indexOf('('); int close = status.indexOf(') - '); if (open > 0 && close > open) { ctx.agent.payload = [:]; ctx.agent.payload.short_name = status.substring(0, open); try { ctx.agent.payload.count = Integer.parseInt(status.substring(open + 1, close)); } catch (Exception e) { ctx.agent.payload.count = 0; } def place = status.substring(close + 4); ctx.agent.last_place = [:]; ctx.agent.last_place.key = place; int slash = place.lastIndexOf('/'); ctx.agent.last_place.name = slash >= 0 ? place.substring(slash + 1) : place; } }
